candidateLayout: Use the original-vfx RP/BP layout, identifiers and sequences.json contract so evaluate.mjs can compare artifacts. Store real capture-report.json and reviewer inspection.json alongside screenshots. Do not copy expected outputs during a model evaluation.

tasks.prompt: Create pm:flame with an original 32 by 256 eight-cell flame atlas, 10 fps looping playback, rising motion, 0.8-second particle life and finite two-second emission. Provide bounded scalable density.
tasks.rubric: Visible animated silhouette, no adjacent-frame bleeding, rising motion and clean end.

tasks.prompt: Create one cyan ground ring expanding from a 0.35-block to an eight-block painted centerline radius over 0.9 seconds. Account for transparent sprite margins. Fade and stop.
tasks.rubric: Circular in the ground plane, correct world scale, smooth outward easing and visible fade.

tasks.prompt: Create a broad directional blizzard with drifting flakes and a separately readable moving gust layer. Emit for five seconds, end by 8.1 seconds, and scale density from 0.4 to 1.5 without changing movement or timing.
tasks.rubric: Large volume, visible near/far flakes, coherent drift, gusts visible separately and together.

tasks.prompt: Create a four-second vertical magical portal with an original rune ring, soft core and orbiting motes, synchronized at time zero.
tasks.rubric: All three layers visible separately; center supports rather than obscures the rune silhouette.

tasks.prompt: Implement a seven-cue boss attack with portal warning, lightning at 1.5 seconds, shockwave and sparks at 1.6, debris at 1.7 and smoke at 1.85. Use stable API 2.9.0, finite jobs, valid entity and chunk checks, and leave/death cancellation.
tasks.rubric: Warning precedes strike; impact layers synchronize; no endless jobs or emitters. Test in game separately.

tasks.prompt: Diagnose evals/fixtures/missing-texture/input. Repair the missing texture using the explicitly approved original ring PNG and preserve its effect behavior. Do not invent the absent source artwork.
tasks.rubric: Clear missing-path diagnosis, real PNG and reviewable minimal diff.

tasks.prompt: Repair the original malformed flame fixture. The intended fade is 1 minus normalized particle age, and its atlas has eight vertical 32-pixel cells. Correct the incomplete expression and ninth frame; retain the ten fps looping animation.
tasks.rubric: Formula intent comes from this request; no speculative general-purpose expression repair.

tasks.prompt: Reduce the 96-spark explosion to 48 while retaining lifetime, velocity, acceleration, sprite, tint and silhouette. Compare matching cameras and times, report the density tradeoff and leave hardware profiling pending.
tasks.rubric: Recognizable burst envelope and color/motion preserved; no claim of pixel-identical appearance or measured hardware gains.

tasks.prompt: Trace pm:shockwave in the original trace fixture to its client alias, source animation, locator and controller. Distinguish dependency connectivity from proof that a controller executes in game.
tasks.rubric: Owner-scoped alias resolution with hashes and file paths; no invented caller.

tasks.prompt: Establish this repository's local stdio MCP connection. Call validation and preview, capture four times, analyze shape/color/motion/scale/opacity/density/timing, and bind the inspection to screenshot and definition hashes.
tasks.rubric: Actual initialization/tool calls, valid PNG evidence and a human-readable visual judgment; runtime remains separate.
